messages:
Elaine (AE): Hey team — MerchantLabs asked for a compact plan for a 2-week eval. They care about legal/security (EU data residency), latency for search assistants, and verifying reranker+embeddings accuracy. Can we map success criteria + blockers?
Ben (SE): Quick Q: do they need 64k context? MerchantLabs said 'long legal bundles up to ~50k tokens'. They also want DB tool-calls.
Omar (ML): 50k tokens is beyond our hosted 32k model catalog. Options: chunk+rerank pipeline, hybrid LLM (32k window) + retrieval, or Dedicated Private with a 64k variant if they run a private model.
Jules (Solutions): Proposed POC approach: 1) ingest sample corpus (5k docs), 2) create embedding index, 3) reranker for top-20, 4) end-to-end eval with merchant test set (100 queries). Success metrics: rerank MRR >= 0.7, recall@10 >= 0.9, median latency (inference + rerank) < 300ms for hosted, <200ms for Dedicated.
Elaine (AE): Timeline host-friendly: Week 0 (kickoff + security Q), Week 1 (ingest + baseline embedding), Week 2 (rerank tweaks + eval + findings). Budget question — what’s rough hosted cost vs Dedicated monthly for this workload?
Ben (SE): Rough estimates: hosted (dev) ~ pay-as-you-go: expect $1.5-3k for a 2-week eval for moderate traffic; Dedicated trial (reserved GPUs) needs sales ops, starts ~$20k/month commitment but gives predictable latency and private network. I'll ping finance for precise numbers.
Priya (Security): Need to confirm: 1) EU data residency for index storage, 2) SOC2 evidence, 3) KMS/HSM support for keys, 4) SSO (SAML) for console. Also confirm whether any PII can be re-used in hosted logs.
Jules (Solutions): We can do an onboarding checklist: NDA (if needed) -> dataset ingest guide -> eval harness (we supply small runner) -> security checklist. For PII: hosted logs are masked by default but advise them to use private if worried.
Omar (ML): Technical note: reranker model should be a cross-encoder for top-20 to hit high MRR. Embeddings for retrieval: use 1536-d open model, test recall. If they insist on 50k context for single-pass QA, recommend chunking with overlap + rerank to simulate long context.
Ben (SE): Tool-calling: we support function/tool calling in hosted models but with restricted outbound network. For DB reads, best to keep connector inside their VPC in Private deployment. For hosted POC we can mock tool calls via a secure proxy.
Elaine (AE): Can we provide a short playbook I can send their infra lead? They asked for a one-page bullet summary.
Jules (Solutions): I'll draft a 1-pager: goals, success metrics, timeline, infra options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), security attachments. Will include sample prompts + eval harness commands.
Ben (SE): Sample eval command we usually share: ```bash
# run rerank eval
python eval/rerank_eval.py --index merchantlabs_index --queries queries.json --topk 20 --cross_encoder model-cross-small --out results.json
```
Omar (ML): Example prompt we use for reranker scoring (for their legal domain): ```
Prompt: "Given the query and candidate clause, score relevance 0-1. Prefer exact clause matches and precedence rules. Output JSON {score:float, reason:string}."```
Elaine (AE): MerchantLabs security lead wants to fill our security questionnaire before kickoff. Priya, can you own the review and return answers in 48h?
Priya (Security): I can. I'll attach SOC2 PDFs and the KMS integration doc. Also flag: if they request full tenant isolation we should propose Dedicated or Private.
Elaine (AE): Potential blockers: contract timeline (legal wants 3 weeks), SSO setup, and data residency. If legal drags, propose a short scoping SOW to start data ingestion only.
Jules (Solutions): For success criteria formalization: deliverables = ingestion report, embedding quality report (precision@10), rerank eval (MRR/recall), latency report, and recommended config (batching, quantization).
Ben (SE): Ops note: we should set up a canary route with fallback to smaller model in case of overload. Example config: ```json
{"routing": {"primary_model":"rwd-32k-v1","fallback":"rwd-8k-quant"}}
``` (we'll send actual config via docs).
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for sandbox workspace at 1938765490 — sandbox env ready.
Elaine (AE): Great. Action items: Jules -> 1-pager + ingest guide by EOD today. Priya -> security questionnaire answers in 48h. Ben -> hosted vs dedicated cost range + canary config. Omar -> baseline eval scripts and prompt templates. I'll coordinate with MerchantLabs for the kick on Monday. :thumbsup:
Ben (SE): LGTM, will follow up with numbers.
Jules (Solutions): Drafting 1-pager now, will post link when ready.
Priya (Security): Starting the questionnaire.
Omar (ML): I'll prep the eval harness and sample queries.
Elaine (AE): Thanks — I'll update MerchantLabs after we post the docs.
